crossRefs.note: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: When the Philistine arose, and walked and came near to meet David, David hurried, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
translations.bsb: As the Philistine started forward to attack him, David ran quickly toward the battle line to meet him.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew nigh to meet David, that David hasted, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew nigh to meet David, that David hastened, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
